title: IoT-Based Solar-Powered Automatic Basin Irrigation System
summary: IARI proposes AI rainfall prediction to avoid unnecessary irrigation when rain is expected. The report separates this proposed extension from its existing soil-moisture automation.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The ITU sequence diagram specifies a proposed AI rainfall-prediction component that asks whether rain is expected tomorrow. A positive forecast leads to closing the irrigation gate, while a negative forecast permits the motor to open it when soil moisture is low. This record concerns that intended AI contribution to water-efficient irrigation. The research-farm controller already uses sensors and preset moisture thresholds. Its reported automation benefits do not establish the effect of the proposed AI extension, and the cited water-saving figure from other research is not a measured result of that extension.
purpose: Use AI rainfall forecasts to avoid unnecessary watering while maintaining suitable soil moisture.
system: Proposed AI rainfall-prediction extension to IARI basin irrigation

ratings.reason: Farmers are intended to benefit from more appropriate irrigation. The source does not establish the extent of an AI-related yield, workload, or livelihood improvement.
Farm operations are intended to avoid unnecessary irrigation using AI rainfall predictions. No measured operational gain from this proposed component is reported.
Reduced water use and more sustainable farming are intended. The extent of savings attributable to the proposed AI component is unassessed.

ai_role.statement: The sequence diagram explicitly proposes AI rainfall prediction as an input to irrigation-gate decisions. Its effect has not been separately evaluated; existing threshold-based automation is a different component.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 2: IoT-Based Solar-Powered Automatic Basin Irrigation System

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good Innovate for Impact, 2025 final report, printed page 819, sequence diagram for the basin-irrigation system. Contributor-supplied proposed AI integration, not an independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Proposed AI rainfall-prediction integration diagram

produced_by: The proposed design combines AI rainfall forecasts with soil-moisture readings and irrigation-gate control.
must_hold: A functioning rainfall-prediction component, appropriate local inputs, soil-moisture sensors, and reliable gate control would be required. The source does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce a benefit.

claim_basis: Two reports from the makers are on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
